SideSpeed 0.4.0 adds a Tools screen, launch-time measurement, an update notice, and live compile status in the Companion.

## What's new
- **Update notice.** The Apps screen tells you when a newer SideSpeed is out, with the Downloader code. It checks GitHub at most once a day and never downloads or installs anything by itself.
- **Tools screen.** A new **Tools** button on the Apps screen opens:
  - **Box health:** device name, Android version, memory, storage and helper status.
  - **Free up space:** **Clean up now** clears app caches. **Automatic cleanup** can keep 500 MB, 1 GB or 2 GB free. It only runs when space is low, never on a timer, and is off by default.
  - **Faster animations:** Normal, Faster or Off. Menus and screen changes move faster; apps do not load faster. **Restore original** puts your old values back.
- **Launch time.** On an app's compile screen, SideSpeed can time how long the app takes to open before and after compiling (it opens the app briefly), for example `1.9 s → 1.1 s (42% faster)`. **Measure** re-checks any app at any time. Results are kept per app version.
- **Live status in the Companion.** The phone and desktop Companion show what SideSpeed is compiling on each TV right now, how many apps are waiting, and the last result. Google TV and other Android TVs can be added just to watch.

## Fixed
- Security: BouncyCastle is updated to 1.85 in the TV app and both Companions.

## Downloads
**On the TV:** open the Downloader app and enter code **3503400**, or go to `sidespeed.app/tv`. Both always get the latest SideSpeed APK.

**Companion:** open `sidespeed.app/phone` on your phone, or see [sidespeed.app](https://sidespeed.app) for the desktop installers.

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `SideSpeed-0.4.0.apk` (also as `SideSpeed.apk`) | The TV app (Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV with Fire OS) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.4.0.apk` (also as `SideSpeed-Companion.apk`) | The companion for Android phones |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.4.0-macos-arm64.dmg` | The companion for macOS (Apple silicon) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.4.0-windows-x64.msi` | The companion for Windows |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.4.0-linux-amd64.deb` / `-x86_64.rpm` | The companion for Linux |

Each companion file is also attached under a name without the version, for links that always point at the latest release.

## Notes
- **Updating:** install over the old version. Your settings are kept. Updating stops the helper, so start it again (Google TV / onn: just open SideSpeed). SideSpeed optimizes itself again the next time you leave it.
- There is no 0.3.0: its Companion live status ships here.
- Fire TV Sticks that run Vega OS are not supported.
- Live status needs SideSpeed 0.4.0 on the TV and the 0.4.0 Companion.
- Both APKs are signed with the project key, which has certificate SHA-256 `5d153f27c68102ff8245e8eb1c6c0a4d4a11d5e1976685824cecb0ce7108cc0c`.
- The desktop installers are unsigned. On macOS, right-click the app and choose **Open**. On Windows, choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

See the [README](https://github.com/DevJardins/SideSpeed#readme) for setup.
